gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent glioblastoma who failed first-line therapy, with no more than 3 prior episodes of disease progression and at least one confirmed and evaluable lesion.

candidate_evidence.quote: Tislelizumab is a drug material authorized for marketing in China. Tislelizumab will be administered off-label in this study. Subjects with recurrent GBM will receive intrathecal tislelizumab every 3 weeks for six times.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Recurrent glioblastoma who failed first-line therapy

role_evidence.quote: the subject will receive a fixed dose of intrathecal PD1 therapy (Tislelizumab 20 mg, d1, Q3W) intrathecal injection every 3 weeks for 6 cycles.
administering PD-1 monoclonal antibodies via intrathecal injection

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody (immune checkpoint inhibitor), given intrathecally
arms: Bevacizumab arterial infusion combined with Tislelizumab intrathecal injection

role_evidence.quote: The aim of this study is to improve the outcome of recurrent GBM patients by changing the route of administration of the two drugs, such as delivering Bevacizumab via intra-arterial infusion

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody, established GBM therapy, given by superselective intra-arterial infusion
arms: Bevacizumab arterial infusion combined with Tislelizumab intrathecal injection

role_evidence.quote: the infusion of 20% mannitol 12.5 ml over 120 seconds prior to the infusion of Bevacizumab

agents.drug_class_hint: osmotic agent, intra-arterial BBB disruption before intra-arterial bevacizumab
arms: Bevacizumab arterial infusion combined with Tislelizumab intrathecal injection

coder_notes: Registry phase NA, but arm text calls it a Phase 2 trial. Single registered intervention 'Tislelizumab and Bevacizumab' split into two agent rows. Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy whose route (superselective intra-arterial) is part of the question -> established_therapy_experiment (rule 6). Tislelizumab (intrathecal) is the only non-established investigational agent -> experimental_monotherapy, formulation new_route. Mannitol is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it before IA bevacizumab; purpose (BBB disruption) not explicitly stated but implied by timing -> delivery_enabling_agent. Inconsistency: interventions text says intrathecal bevacizumab via Ommaya, arm text says arterial infusion. cns5 'historical' from 'Glioblastoma multiforme' in description (no IDH requirement).
